const container = d3.select("body")
  .append("div")
  .attr("id", "chart-container")
  .style("background", "#f5f5f5")
  .style("padding", "40px")
  .style("min-height", "100vh")
  .style("box-sizing", "border-box")
  .style("font-family", "system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif");

const margin = {top: 60, right: 40, bottom: 80, left: 70};
const width = 900 - margin.left - margin.right;
const height = 500 - margin.top - margin.bottom;

const svg = container.append("svg")
  .attr("width", width + margin.left + margin.right)
  .attr("height", height + margin.top + margin.bottom)
  .style("background", "#ffffff")
  .style("border-radius", "12px")
  .style("box-shadow", "0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)")
  .append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(${margin.left},${margin.top})`);

const data = [
  {category: "Q1 2023", value: 45},
  {category: "Q2 2023", value: 72},
  {category: "Q3 2023", value: 58},
  {category: "Q4 2023", value: 91},
  {category: "Q1 2024", value: 68},
  {category: "Q2 2024", value: 85},
  {category: "Q3 2024", value: 77},
  {category: "Q4 2024", value: 94}
];

const x = d3.scaleBand()
  .domain(data.map(d => d.category))
  .range([0, width])
  .padding(0.35);

const y = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain([0, 100])
  .range([height, 0]);

const defs = svg.append("defs");
const gradient = defs.append("linearGradient")
  .attr("id", "barGradient")
  .attr("x1", "0%")
  .attr("y1", "0%")
  .attr("x2", "0%")
  .attr("y2", "100%");

gradient.append("stop")
  .attr("offset", "0%")
  .attr("stop-color", "#6366f1");

gradient.append("stop")
  .attr("offset", "100%")
  .attr("stop-color", "#4f46e5");

svg.append("g")
  .attr("transform", `translate(0,${height})`)
  .call(d3.axisBottom(x).tickSize(0).tickPadding(15))
  .selectAll("text")
  .style("font-size", "13px")
  .style("fill", "#6b7280")
  .style("font-weight", "500");

svg.append("g")
  .call(d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(6).tickSize(-width).tickPadding(10))
  .call(g => g.select(".domain").remove())
  .call(g => g.selectAll(".tick line")
    .attr("stroke", "#e5e7eb")
    .attr("stroke-dasharray", "2,2"))
  .call(g => g.selectAll(".tick text")
    .style("font-size", "12px")
    .style("fill", "#9ca3af"));

svg.append("text")
  .attr("x", width / 2)
  .attr("y", -35)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("font-size", "22px")
  .style("font-weight", "700")
  .style("fill", "#111827")
  .text("Quarterly Revenue Growth");

svg.append("text")
  .attr("x", width / 2)
  .attr("y", -12)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("font-size", "14px")
  .style("fill", "#6b7280")
  .text("Revenue indexed to baseline (0-100 scale)");

const bars = svg.selectAll(".bar")
  .data(data)
  .enter()
  .append("rect")
  .attr("class", "bar")
  .attr("x", d => x(d.category))
  .attr("width", x.bandwidth())
  .attr("y", height)
  .attr("height", 0)
  .attr("fill", "url(#barGradient)")
  .attr("rx", 6)
  .attr("ry", 6)
  .style("cursor", "pointer")
  .style("filter", "drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(79,70,229,0.2))");

bars.transition()
  .duration(1200)
  .delay((d, i) => i * 120)
  .ease(d3.easeElasticOut.amplitude(1).period(0.6))
  .attr("y", d => y(d.value))
  .attr("height", d => height - y(d.value));

const labels = svg.selectAll(".value-label")
  .data(data)
  .enter()
  .append("text")
  .attr("class", "value-label")
  .attr("x", d => x(d.category) + x.bandwidth() / 2)
  .attr("y", height)
  .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
  .style("font-size", "13px")
  .style("font-weight", "700")
  .style("fill", "#374151")
  .style("opacity", 0)
  .text(d => d.value);

labels.transition()
  .duration(1200)
  .delay((d, i) => i * 120 + 600)
  .ease(d3.easeCubicOut)
  .attr("y", d => y(d.value) - 10)
  .style("opacity", 1);

bars.on("mouseenter", function(event, d) {
  d3.select(this)
    .transition()
    .duration(200)
    .style("filter", "drop-shadow(0 4px 12px rgba(79,70,229,0.4))")
    .attr("transform", `scale(1.05, 1) translate(${-x.bandwidth() * 0.025}, 0)`);
})
.on("mouseleave", function(event, d) {
  d3.select(this)
    .transition()
    .duration(200)
    .style("filter", "drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(79,70,229,0.2))")
    .attr("transform", "scale(1, 1)");
});
